corrections.claim: Recover from a refusal: what a refusal leaves
corrections.before: A refused upload or type correction adds no Version and leaves the chain as it was.
corrections.after: A refused upload, type correction, or Version delete leaves the chain as it was.
corrections.source: routes.ts version DELETE runs in one transaction and throws before any delete on a refusal; storage deletes follow the row deletes inside the transaction

confirmed.source: routes.ts requireAdministrator on both DELETE routes; documents-card.tsx canErase; portal documents-section.tsx has no delete

limitations: The whole-Document delete route (DELETE /documents/:documentId) still exists, but the Documents section no longer offers it. The row menu and the bulk toolbar now delete Versions (bulk: the current Version of each selected Document). The guide does not describe bulk deletion; archive-and-delete-documents.md does and is now wrong (see sharedFileRequests).

On an archived owning record, the Document row's Actions menu is hidden, but an Administrator still sees Delete version in an earlier Version's menu (VersionActions renders when canErase regardless of frozen). The API reaches archived records for erasure. The guide does not describe this edge; the walkthrough need not test it.
The registry negative check for insufficient access applies to Version delete as well: a Legal Team Member sees no Delete version item and the API answers 403.

productBugs: dd28e33d adds per-Version delete (apps/api/src/modules/documents/routes.ts DELETE /documents/:documentId/versions/:versionId; documents-card.tsx Delete version; bulk-document-actions.tsx Delete versions). DOC-001 ('Individual versions are never edited or deleted') and DOC-010 ('Individual versions can never be deleted'; per-version delete 'breaks the negotiation record') say it must not exist, and the DOC-010/DOC-011 UX addendum says the delete dialog explains that all versions are deleted. No addendum records the change. Either the records need a superseding addendum or the build is wrong. The UI also no longer offers whole-Document hard delete; erasing a Document now takes one delete per Version.
229909d4 adds Partially signed as a seventh fixed Contract Document type. DOC-015 still says the Contract list starts with six negotiation types. Record drift; needs a DOC-015 addendum.

Carried from DOC-030, still present at 4ca41822: documents-card.tsx TypeCell renders an editable select on a Knowledge Item's files, and every change is refused (409 or 400). DOC-015 Knowledge addendum says the label is derived and Knowledge has no list, so the cell should be read-only.
sharedFileRequests: docs/user-guides/archive-and-delete-documents.md: the Delete this document? dialog, the Delete action and 'You cannot delete just one Version' are wrong at 4ca41822. The row menu says Delete version, the dialog is 'Delete version N?', the bulk toolbar says Delete versions and deletes only the current Version of each selected Document, and deleting the last Version removes the Document (dd28e33d).
docs/user-guides/reference.md line 68: 'There is no individual-Version delete action' is wrong; an Administrator can delete one Version (dd28e33d).
